OECD reports no ISIC C21 value for Australia. ABS Research and Experimental Development Businesses Australia 2023-24, Table 1 (81040DO003_202324.xlsx): 'Basic chemical and chemical product manufacturing' (ANZSIC subdivision 18, which contains pharmaceutical and medicinal product manufacturing) total R&D expenditure AUD 947.9 million, divided by GDP 2024 AUD 2,680,025 million (World Bank NY.GDP.MKTP.CN). Upper bound for manufacturing-based pharma R&D; consistent with Medicines Australia Facts Book 2021 ('upwards of $1 billion in R&D each year'). Clinical-trial R&D performed by CROs is classified under professional, scientific and technical services and is not captured.
